verses.text: Then I looked, and there in front of me was the Lamb, standing on Mount Zion. With him were one hundred and forty-four thousand people who had his name and his Father's name written on their foreheads.
I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of rushing waters and like loud thunder. The sound I heard was like people playing their harps.

They sang a new song in front of the throne, the four living creatures, and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred and forty-four thousand who had been bought back from the earth.

These are the ones who did not make themselves impure with women, for they kept themselves pure. They follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were bought back from among people as the first harvest for God and the Lamb.
No lie was found in their mouths. They are without fault.
Then I saw another angel flying high in the sky. He had the Good News that lasts forever to announce to the people who live on the earth, to every nation, tribe, language, and people.
He said in a loud voice, "Fear God and give him glory, because the time has come for him to judge. Worship him who made the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the springs of water!"
A second angel followed him and said, "Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the great! She made all the nations drink the wine of her sexual sin, which brings God's anger."
A third angel followed them and said in a loud voice, "If anyone worships the beast and its statue, and receives its mark on his forehead or on his hand,
he will also drink the wine of God's anger, poured full strength into the cup of his anger. He will suffer pain with fire and burning sulphur in front of the holy angels and the Lamb.
The smoke of their pain rises forever and ever. There is no rest day or night for those who worship the beast and its statue, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name."
This is why God's holy people need to keep going patiently. They obey God's commands and keep their faith in Jesus.

Then I heard a voice from heaven say, "Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on." "Yes," says the Spirit, "they will rest from their hard work, because the good things they did will go with them."
Then I looked, and there was a white cloud. Sitting on the cloud was someone like a son of man. He had a gold crown on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.

Then another angel came out of the temple and called in a loud voice to the one sitting on the cloud, "Use your sickle and gather the harvest, because the time has come. The harvest of the earth is ripe!"
So the one sitting on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

And another angel, who has power over fire, came from the altar. He called in a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle, "Use your sharp sickle and gather the bunches of grapes from the earth's vine, because its grapes are ripe!"
So the angel swung his sickle on the earth, gathered its grapes, and threw them into the great winepress of God's anger.
The grapes were crushed in the winepress outside the city. Blood flowed out of the winepress, as high as the horses' bridles, for about three hundred kilometres.
